purpose: Generation 10 readiness derived from the actual LeafGreen ROM/SAV pairs before form-change work.

policy.oversize_rom_files: probe-only; not uniquely addressable without a nonstandard mapper/banking design

waitstate_windows.semantics: ROM1 and ROM2 address the same 32 MiB ROM data with different waitstates; they are not extra storage

expanded_half.use: relocated data tables and assets; code placement requires branch/range review

oversize_probe.result: 64/96/128 MiB files can be constructed, but bytes after 32 MiB are outside the standard LeafGreen/GBA unique ROM window

save_evidence.tail_slack_policy: not used in phase 1 because increasing per-section checksum sizes would make unmodified legacy saves fail validation without a migration loader

SaveBlock1_unused_348C.status: reserved for future audited extension metadata

species.reason_for_phase1_pokedex_capacity: two 4096-bit fields exactly fit the verified 0x400-byte SaveBlock2 filler

moves.blocker: LevelUpMove.move is a 9-bit field; IDs above 511 require a new learnset encoding

abilities.status: requires widening/interoperability design before modern ability import

types.status: table/UI expansion only; physical save growth not required

move_effects.status: requires widened runtime representation if effects exceed 255

phase1_order: validate every ROM together with its 128 KiB save
enforce the 32 MiB standard LeafGreen/GBA hard ROM limit
keep the save physical size at 128 KiB
reserve SaveBlock2 filler_B20 as the 4096-species extended seen/owned Pokedex block
inventory and relocate species/move/item/ability/type/evolution tables inside the 32 MiB ROM window
replace the 9-bit level-up move encoding before importing move IDs above 511
design ability-slot widening without changing BoxPokemon size or breaking old saves
only after the expansion layer is stable, resume form-change mechanics
